features.name: temperature_niche_breadth_c

features.name: forest_2000_share_occupied_cells

features.name: recent_forest_loss_share_occupied_cells
features.description: tree-cover loss 2015-2024 (share of 2000 tree cover) in the ~5 km cells with records

features.name: built_up_share_occupied_cells
features.description: built-up share of land in the ~5 km cells with records (human pressure)

training_data.feature_source: GBIF occurrence search facets for India; range from all loaded records on a ~50 km grid; protected-area, climate-niche and land-use (Hansen forest change, GHSL built-up) features from records located within 10 km; no location-precision flag (leakage guard)
training_data.excluded_from_training: Data Deficient species and species without a verified assessment

disclaimer: MODEL PREDICTION - not an official IUCN Red List assessment.
